mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mail_forward_setting ( user_id, use_yn, forward_email, keep_original_yn, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, COALESCE(#{useYn,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'N'), LOWER(#{forwardEmail,jdbcType=VARCHAR}), COALESCE(#{keepOriginalYn,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'Y'), now(), now() ) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET use_yn = EXCLUDED.use_yn, forward_email = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.forward_email, mail_forward_setting.forward_email), keep_original_yn = EXCLUDED.keep_original_yn, updated_at = now()
mapper.select: SELECT FROM mail_forward_rule f WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.sort_order, f.mail_fwd_rule_idx
SELECT FROM mail_forward_rule f WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY CASE f.match_type WHEN 'EMAIL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, f.sort_order, f.mail_fwd_rule_idx
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mail_forward_rule ( user_id, match_type, match_val, forward_email, use_yn, sort_order, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{matchType}, LOWER(#{matchVal}), LOWER(#{forwardEmail}), COALESCE(#{useYn,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'Y'), COALESCE(#{sortOrder,jdbcType=INTEGER}, 0), now(), now() )
mapper.update: UPDATE mail_forward_rule SET match_type = COALESCE(#{matchType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, match_type), match_val = COALESCE(LOWER(#{matchVal,jdbcType=VARCHAR}), match_val), forward_email = COALESCE(LOWER(#{forwardEmail,jdbcType=VARCHAR}), forward_email), use_yn = COALESCE(#{useYn,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, use_yn), sort_order = COALESCE(#{sortOrder,jdbcType=INTEGER}, sort_order), updated_at = now() WHERE mail_fwd_rule_idx = #{ruleIdx} AND user_id = #{userId}
